hooks.name: Garde-fou fictif
hooks.description: Vérifie que les fixtures et le seed Supabase restent entièrement fictifs.

action.prompt: Review the saved file with this instruction: Every person, organisation and place must be FICTIONAL (examples: Ville-Exemple, FC Démo, AS Test, Ministre de l'Exemple). Flag any real person's name, any quote attributed to a real person, and any URL that is not example.org. If everything is fine, answer in one line: OK fictif. Otherwise list the lines to fix. Do not edit files and do not run commands.
